ache.title: “Loved every moment” is how loops start
ache.note: Nero says he loved every moment of Zenless Zone Zero’s early days. Early-game joy is real, and it’s also the honeymoon the game uses to settle you in before dailies and banners take over. Enjoy it, and keep an eye on the day it stops being fun and starts being a chore.
watch: a honeymoon before the chores begin
community pull to keep logging in
ache.tip: Check in with yourself in a month: still fun, or just a habit? Be honest. Either answer is okay.
lines: the honeymoon always ends. that’s normal
I’ll ask you in a month. be ready
